title: Colimits of presheaves of sets and of abelian groups are computed sectionwise
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category, let $\mathcal A$ be the category of sets or the category of abelian groups, and let $\mathrm{PSh}(\mathcal C;\mathcal A)$ be the category of presheaves on $\mathcal C$ with values in $\mathcal A$ (functors $\mathcal C^{op}\to\mathcal A$, morphisms the natural transformations). Let $\mathcal I$ be a small category and $i\mapsto\mathcal F_i$ a diagram $\mathcal I\to\mathrm{PSh}(\mathcal C;\mathcal A)$. For every object $V$ of $\mathcal C$ let $(\mathcal P(V),(\iota_{i,V})_i)$ be a colimit of the diagram $i\mapsto\mathcal F_i(V)$ in $\mathcal A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and for a morphism $g:V'\to V$ of $\mathcal C$ let $\mathcal P(g):\mathcal P(V)\to\mathcal P(V')$ be the unique morphism of $\mathcal A$ with $\mathcal P(g)\circ\iota_{i,V}=\iota_{i,V'}\circ\mathcal F_i(g)$ for all $i$. Then $\mathcal P$ is a presheaf ($\mathcal P(\mathrm{id})=\mathrm{id}$, $\mathcal P(g\circ h)=\mathcal P(h)\circ\mathcal P(g)$), the families $\iota_i=(\iota_{i,V})_V$ are morphisms of presheaves $\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal P$, and $(\mathcal P,(\iota_i)_i)$ is a colimit of the diagram in $\mathrm{PSh}(\mathcal C;\mathcal A)$: for every presheaf $\mathcal Q$ and morphisms $\mu_i:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal Q$ with $\mu_j\circ\mathcal F(a)=\mu_i$ for all $a:i\to j$ there is exactly one morphism $u:\mathcal P\to\mathcal Q$ with $u\circ\iota_i=\mu_i$ for all $i$, namely $u_V$ the morphism induced by the $\mu_{i,V}$.
